name: Las Vegas
operatingHours: The Las Vegas Monorail runs along the east side of the Strip from MGM Grand to SAHARA (7 stations, ~15 min end to end, every 4–8 min): Mon 7:00 AM–12:00 AM, Tue–Thu 7:00 AM–2:00 AM, Fri–Sun 7:00 AM–3:00 AM. Free resort trams link Bellagio–Aria–Park MGM (~8:00 AM–2:00 AM) and Mandalay Bay–Luxor–Excalibur (~10:00 AM–12:00 AM). RTC's Deuce bus runs the Strip to Downtown 24 h.
fareInfo: Monorail single ride $6 ($5.50 online), 24-hour pass $15 ($13.45 online), 2-day $26, 3-day $32 (2026); buy at station machines or in the monorail app and tap at the gates. RTC buses (Deuce, SDX) use separate tickets in the rideRTC app: 2-hour pass ~$6, 24-hour ~$8.

sights.name: Fountains of Bellagio
sights.note: Free water-and-light shows choreographed to music on the lake in front of the Bellagio, the Strip's signature spectacle.
sights.hours: Shows every 30 min from 3:00 PM (12:00 PM weekends), every 15 min 8:00 PM–12:00 AM; free

sights.name: Fremont Street Experience
sights.note: Downtown's pedestrian street of old-school casinos under a LED canopy that comes alive with hourly light shows, with a zipline overhead.
sights.hours: Street always open; canopy shows hourly ~6:00 PM–1:00 AM

sights.name: Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Garden
sights.note: A glass-roofed atrium off the Bellagio lobby with elaborate floral displays that change with each season; free.

sights.name: High Roller
sights.note: A 167 m observation wheel at the end of the LINQ Promenade, with 30-minute rides in glass cabins (some with an open bar).

sights.name: The Las Vegas Strip
sights.note: Six kilometres of Las Vegas Boulevard lined with themed mega-resorts, free shows and replicas from Venice to Paris, best walked at night.

sights.name: The Mob Museum
sights.note: The National Museum of Organized Crime and Law Enforcement in a 1933 federal courthouse downtown, with a basement speakeasy and distillery.

sights.name: The Neon Museum
sights.note: A boneyard of rescued casino signs north of downtown, best seen on an evening tour when the restored signs are lit.
sights.hours: Daily ~2:00 PM to ~10:00 PM–12:00 AM (seasonal); timed entry

sights.name: The STRAT Tower (SkyPod)
sights.note: The tallest observation tower in the US at 350 m, with indoor and outdoor decks and thrill rides hanging off the top.
sights.hours: Sun–Thu ~10:00 AM–1:00 AM, Fri–Sat to 2:00 AM

sights.name: Titanic: The Artifact Exhibition
sights.note: Recovered artefacts and full-scale room recreations from RMS Titanic, including a section of its hull, inside the Luxor.

sights.name: The LINQ Promenade
sights.note: An open-air pedestrian street of bars, restaurants and shops between the Strip and the High Roller.

sights.name: Pinball Hall of Fame
sights.note: A huge non-profit arcade of playable pinball and arcade machines from the 1950s onward, at the south end of the Strip near the Welcome sign.
sights.hours: Sun–Thu 10:00 AM–11:00 PM, Fri–Sat 10:00 AM–12:00 AM

sights.name: Eiffel Tower Viewing Deck
sights.note: A half-scale Eiffel Tower at Paris Las Vegas whose 46-storey deck looks straight across at the Bellagio fountains.

sights.name: Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas Sign
sights.note: The 1959 neon 'Welcome' sign in the median of Las Vegas Boulevard south of the Strip, with a small parking lot for photos.

sights.name: The Atomic Museum
sights.note: A Smithsonian affiliate east of the Strip telling the story of nuclear testing in the Nevada desert, with a simulated test in the Ground Zero Theater.

sights.name: Las Vegas Arts District (18b)
sights.note: Eighteen blocks between the Strip and downtown packed with galleries, vintage shops, craft breweries and taquerias, liveliest on First Friday.

airports.name: Harry Reid International Airport
airports.transitNote: No rail link: the monorail stops ~2 km short at MGM Grand. Taxis and rideshares reach the Strip in 10–20 min; RTC bus CX (Centennial Express) from Terminal 1 and 3 runs up the Strip to Downtown in ~30–45 min (not on the map).
airports.hours: Airport buses run ~24 h on the CX/109 routes; monorail at MGM Grand opens 7:00 AM.
